summary: Israel's Defense Minister Katz expressed a desire to resume hostilities against Iran, claiming US forces are conducting strikes from Israeli airbases. Concurrently, large-scale UAV attacks have been reported targeting multiple locations in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. Israeli forces have also reported destroying underground infrastructure in northern Gaza.
key_points: Israeli Defense Minister Katz stated a desire to resume war against Iran, claiming US aircraft are launching strikes in Iran from Israeli airbases. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85862)
Large-scale UAV attacks have targeted Erbil, Koya, Soran, Kormor, Khalifan, and other areas in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, with jets intercepting them. (Source: @shin_persian/8555)
Israeli forces, including the Northern Brigade and Yahalom units, destroyed a Hamas underground tunnel infrastructure hundreds of meters long in northern Gaza. (Source: @inon_yttach/9693)
Israeli Defense Minister Katz claimed that the areas of Shuja'iyya and Jabalia in Gaza no longer exist. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85868)
The Israeli Air Force intercepted a UAV detected near the Jordanian border that did not enter Israeli territory. (Source: @yediotnews25/133297)
Israeli forces killed a Nukhba fighter from Islamic Jihad involved in the release of an Israeli citizen and a Hamas police commander. (Source: @almogboker78/17832)
Israeli military alerts were activated in the Kisufim area. (Source: @New_security8200/203013)
An Israeli settler released livestock on Palestinian lands in Sinjil, Ramallah, in the West Bank. (Source: @presstv/200602)

sections.threat_assessment: The threat level is high due to reported UAV incursions in Iraq and Israel's stated intent to resume hostilities against Iran. The potential for US-led strikes from Israeli bases adds a layer of regional escalation risk. The destruction of underground infrastructure in Gaza indicates ongoing high-intensity combat operations.
sections.regional_response: Diplomatic efforts involving Oman, Qatar, Pakistan, Egypt, and US envoys are attempting to facilitate negotiations with Iran. However, Israeli leadership has expressed dissatisfaction with current constraints and a desire for more aggressive military action.
sections.intelligence_notes: The reported UAV attacks in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq suggest a significant escalation in cross-border aerial activity. The reported destruction of Hamas tunnels by Yahalom units indicates a focus on neutralizing subterranean combat capabilities in Gaza.
